question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**valuable**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word refers to something of great importance or usefulness in a specific context.
 
• The term '**valuable**' describes something that has significant value, importance, or worth, often in a non-material sense. (मूल्यवान)
 
 
• **Example**: Water is a valuable resource that needs to be conserved.
 
 
 
• '**Valuable**', in this context, signifies the importance and worth of children as critical assets for the future of any country. (मूल्यवान)
 
• Hence, the correct choice is **valuable**.

Therefore, the correct answer is “**Option 3**”.

 

**Complete Passage**: *Children are the future of any country and a country that does not take care of this valuable__ resource suffers later. A successful nation is that which makes its youth strong enough to lift this (2) ________ responsibility on their shoulders. (3) ________, this is not the case in our country. Education, which is a necessity, is still a (4) ________ here. Poor people (5) ________ to send their children to school.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Valued **implies something that is highly regarded or held in high esteem. It often refers to the emotional or sentimental worth rather than intrinsic value. (मूल्यवान)

 
 
• **Example**: His advice is always **valued **by his peers.
 
 
 
• **Extravagant **means lacking restraint in spending money or using resources. It can also refer to something that is excessive or over the top. (फिजूलखर्ची)
 
 
• **Example**: The **extravagant **wedding cost millions.
 
 
 
• **Worthless **describes something that has no monetary value or usefulness. It suggests that something is of no importance or value. (बेकार)
 
 
• **Example**: The broken vase was considered **worthless **by the owner.
